title: Virtual Care Encounters Held by One Patient
content:
Virtual Care sets no overall cap on the number of encounters one patient holds. A patient may hold any number of virtual encounters over time and across visit types; how many may be started within a week, and how many may wait at once, is governed by the Virtual Care rule on weekly frequency and open requests of one visit type.

## The rule in parts

| Question | Answer under this rule |
|---|---|
| Is there a ceiling on the total number of Virtual Care encounters a patient holds over time? | No. |
| Is there a ceiling on the number of visit types a patient uses? | No. A patient may hold encounters of any of the six visit types: Portal E-Visit, Audio-Only Phone Visit, Primary Care Video Visit, Behavioral Health Video Visit, Specialty Video Follow-Up and On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care. |
| What limits how many encounters are started within a week, and how many wait at once? | The Virtual Care rule on weekly frequency and open requests of one visit type. |

## Illustration (hypothetical patient)

A hypothetical patient has, over two years, eleven completed Virtual Care encounters across four visit types. Those encounters reach no cap on encounters held, because Virtual Care sets none; whether a further encounter may be started this week, or may wait alongside another, is the matter the weekly frequency and open-request rule governs.
